summary: Admit the exact OMP producer and shipped extension before interrupted-ask repair

replay.detail: No graph replay or persisted claim changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Interrupted-ask repair uses the same exact producer and shipped-extension admission as interactive launch. It may run isolated admission probes before repair; a failed admission cannot touch the selected transcript. Minor-version admission is not retained. Reopened asks name their tool call in the existing reason field, and malformed transcript rows no longer hide later valid rows.

downtime.detail: An uncached exact producer/extension identity can add bounded isolated admission probes before repair. Unchanged exact identities reuse measured results; no additional daemon restart is required.

manual.detail: No new manual step is required. Existing exact-build admission and override controls apply.

recovery.detail: Repair refusal leaves the selected transcript unchanged; interactive launch still applies its own admission gate.
